about: Fact goals: a number or date that sits in a page's text, often under a tab, a toggle or a heading the outline shows without it. Each case starts at its site's home page. A run succeeds when the navigator reports Reached, the final URL or title contains one of the keywords, and the page's text shows one of the `answer` strings. Answers change over time (prices) and with where the eval runs (Stripe shows local fees); update them when a site does. Run with `aibrowse eval navigator --suite evals/facts.json`.

cases.name: github_copilot_business_price
cases.goal: the price per user per month of GitHub Copilot Business
